There is a clear lack of maintenance of both the machines and the premises. The gym often has a bad odour, feels unhygienic, and even has issues with mosquitoes. A significant portion of the crowd behaves immaturely (commonly referred to as “chapri”), with little sense of gym etiquette or respectful communication. The gym itself is spacious, clean, and very well equipped. Whether it is weight training, cardio, or functional workouts, everything needed is available, and the machines are modern and well maintained, even during peak hours.

Another great decision was training under Omkar Yadav (IG: @omiyadav55). Omi took the time to understand my goals, lifestyle, and starting point. He helped correct my form, pushed me to my limits when needed, pulled me back when I was overdoing it, and always kept things realistic and sustainable. He is extremely focused on technique and safety, and the way he corrects mistakes is encouraging, never critical.

Doing weight training and cardio six days a week made a huge difference, especially in building strength and gaining back my form. What I really appreciate is how invested Omi is in my progress.

What also stood out to me at Gold’s Gym Mulund is the positive and friendly environment. All the trainers and staff are supportive, which makes it much easier to stay consistent.

The results speak for themselves from 115 kg to 104 kg but for me, the bigger change has been mental. Better energy levels, improved discipline, and a healthier routine overall.

I am truly grateful to everyone at Gold’s Gym Mulund, especially Omi, for creating a space where real change is possible. This journey is still ongoing, but it has taught me that with consistency, the right guidance, and the right environment you can achieve anything.
